mapper.select: SELECT T.create_user as launchUser, T.TRADE_ID AS portfolioId, NVL(fp.FINPROD_ABBR,T.TRADE_ID) portfolioName, T.NEXT_USER AS nextUser, T.CRT_DATE AS createTaskTime, sd.institution_code instCode FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su on T.CRT_USER =su.user_name LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON SU.DEPT_CODE = sd.Dept_Code left join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_market_id = t.TRADE_ID and fp.finprod_type = 'F16' WHERE T.PROCESS_STATE != 'END' AND T.BUSINESS_TYPE = #{businessType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and T.crt_date <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}
